translate_en|mods/Meat Expansion 2.0/42/: Controls how often Beaver hunting signs appear while foraging. Best areas: Deep Forest and Forest, followed by Vegetation. 0 disables Beaver encounters.
Controls how often Bison hunting signs appear while foraging. Best areas: Farmland and Farms, with smaller chances in Forest and Vegetation. 0 disables Bison encounters.
When enabled, Pheasant encounters use the classic dead-bird visual after the bird sign is opened. The successful hunt still drops the custom Pheasant carcass.
Controls how often Elk hunting signs appear while foraging. Best areas: Deep Forest and Forest, followed by Vegetation and Farmland. 0 disables Elk encounters.
Disable to prevent new beavers forage encounters.
Disable to prevent new bison forage encounters.
Disable to prevent new elk forage encounters.
Disable to prevent new grizzly bears forage encounters.
Disable to prevent new hunting forage encounters.
Disable to prevent new kangaroos forage encounters.
Disable to prevent new ostrich eggs forage encounters.
Disable to prevent new ostriches forage encounters.
Disable to prevent new pheasant eggs forage encounters.
Disable to prevent new pheasants forage encounters.
Controls how often Grizzly Bear hunting signs appear while foraging. Best areas: Deep Forest and Forest. They are intentionally very rare near towns. 0 disables Grizzly Bear encounters.
Boosts Meat Expansion hunting encounters in Town, Trailer Park, and navigation or road-style zones. Animals remain naturally less common here unless this setting is increased.
Controls how often Kangaroo hunting signs appear while foraging. Best areas: Farmland, Farms, and Vegetation. 0 disables Kangaroo encounters.
When enabled, the Meat Expansion Hunting debug menu can manually spawn animal hunting encounters. Disable this for a fully natural foraging and hunting experience.
Controls how many raw meat portions a successful hunted carcass contains. Higher values increase yield. Shot quality and excessive weapon power can still reduce usable meat.
Boosts ALL Meat Expansion hunting encounters in Forest, Deep Forest, Farmland, Farm, and Vegetation zones. This stacks with Overall Animal Encounter Frequency and each animal's own setting.
Controls how often Ostrich Eggs appear as normal forage finds. Best areas: Farms and Farmland. This is a forage item, not a hunting encounter. 0 disables Ostrich Egg finds.
Controls how often Ostrich hunting signs appear while foraging. Best areas: Farms and Farmland, followed by Vegetation. 0 disables Ostrich encounters.
Global multiplier for ALL Meat Expansion hunting encounters. This stacks with each animal's individual frequency. 4 is normal. 8 to 10 are intended for heavy spawning and testing.
Controls how often Pheasant Eggs appear as normal forage finds. They are found directly while foraging and are not hunting encounters. 0 disables Pheasant Egg finds.
Controls how often Pheasant hunting signs appear while foraging. Best areas: Deep Forest, Vegetation, Forest, Farmland, and Farms. 0 disables Pheasant encounters.
